data_baseline.rule: Feature builders must verify the frozen DATA baseline before materialization. Any changed frozen input requires an explicit post-DATA migration, not silent consumption.

fighter_state_primitives.grain: one pre-fight fighter state row for each participant in each canonical UFC target fight

information_cutoff.rule: A historical fight is eligible only when its canonical event_date is strictly earlier than the target fight event_date.
information_cutoff.same_day_policy: Same-day fights are excluded as prior evidence because canonical v0 does not freeze trustworthy intra-event bout chronology for early tournament cards.

history_scope.outcomes_and_experience: All canonical promotions may contribute when event_date is strictly before target_event_date.
history_scope.round_stat_primitives: Only prior fights with a complete paired canonical fighter_round_stats surface and valid canonical round exposure timing contribute round-stat primitives.
history_scope.external_fight_rule: Bellator/ONE canonical history can contribute experience/outcome context but cannot fabricate UFC-style round statistics that are absent from canonical data.

recent3.definition: up to the three most recent eligible prior stat-observed fights
recent3.boundary_tie_rule: If more fights share the boundary event_date than can be selected without inventing same-day order, recent3 stat primitives are null and recent3_boundary_ambiguous=true.

recent5.definition: up to the five most recent eligible prior stat-observed fights
recent5.boundary_tie_rule: If more fights share the boundary event_date than can be selected without inventing same-day order, recent5 stat primitives are null and recent5_boundary_ambiguous=true.

ewm365.definition: all eligible prior stat-observed fights weighted by calendar recency
ewm365.note: Mechanical baseline only; this is not a tuned model hyperparameter. Same-day historical fights receive equal weight because no ordering is inferred.

null_rules.no_prior_history: counts are observed zeros; rate-ready statistical numerators/denominators remain zero but downstream ratios with zero denominator must be null
null_rules.ambiguous_recent_window: window primitives null; ambiguity flag true
null_rules.missing_or_incomplete_round_pair: fight excluded from stat windows, preserved in audit counts; never treated as zero statistics
null_rules.domain_missingness: Each rate domain carries its own observed exposure seconds. A round contributes a domain only when the paired fighter/opponent source values required by that domain are present; missing fields never borrow full-fight exposure and never become zero.

lineage.rule: Every included historical fight is emitted with target fight, fighter, history date, promotion, stat eligibility, recent-window membership, and EWM weight so leakage can be independently audited.
